name: BLE Pendant
description: Audio streaming, transcription, intent detection, task management, location-based reminders, and long-term memory from BLE pendant devices
author: OpenClaw

sttProvider.description: Speech-to-text provider for pendant audio. Options: 'deepgram' (cloud), 'whisper' (self-hosted), 'gateway' (built-in).

deepgramApiKey.description: Deepgram API key. Required if sttProvider is 'deepgram'. Get one at https://console.deepgram.com

whisperEndpoint.description: Whisper API endpoint URL. Required if sttProvider is 'whisper'. Example: http://localhost:9000/v1/audio/transcriptions

autoTranscribe.description: Automatically transcribe incoming pendant audio. Set to false to manually trigger transcription.

bufferDurationMs.description: Audio buffer duration in milliseconds before sending for transcription. Lower values = faster response, higher values = better accuracy.

enableSpeakerDiarization.description: Enable speaker diarization to identify and track different speakers by their voice.

speakerMatchThreshold.description: Confidence threshold (0-1) for matching voices to known profiles. Higher = stricter matching.

autoCreateVoiceProfiles.description: Automatically create voice profiles for unrecognized speakers.

enableIntentDetection.description: Enable automatic intent detection from transcripts (task creation, memory save, etc.).

intentConfidenceThreshold.description: Minimum confidence (0-1) required to act on a detected intent. Lower = more aggressive, higher = more conservative.

autoSaveToMemory.description: Automatically save pendant transcripts to long-term memory files for later search.

memoryFlushIntervalMs.description: How often to flush transcript buffer to memory files (milliseconds).

memoryFlushMinEntries.description: Minimum number of transcript entries before flushing to memory.

locationDefaultRadiusMeters.description: Default geofence radius in meters for saved locations.

locationReminderMode.description: How to alert when a location-based reminder triggers. 'notification' = system notification, 'ai_message' = send to AI, 'both' = both methods.

enableSoftwareVAD.description: Enable software Voice Activity Detection to skip silence. This is redundant with the pendant's hardware VAD but provides a safety net to avoid wasting STT API calls on silence.

vadEnergyThreshold.description: RMS energy threshold for speech detection (0-1). Audio frames below this level are considered silence. Lower = more sensitive, higher = stricter.

vadSpeechRatio.description: Minimum ratio of audio frames that must exceed the energy threshold to consider the buffer as containing speech (0-1). Lower = more permissive.

tools.name: voice_profile_list
tools.description: List all known voice profiles (people whose voices have been fingerprinted)

tools.name: voice_profile_identify
tools.description: Assign a name/identity to a voice profile (link a voice to a person)

tools.name: pendant_channel_status
tools.description: Get status of the pendant audio channel including speaker history

tools.name: pendant_control
tools.description: Control BLE pendant device connected to Android node (scan, connect, disconnect, status)

tools.name: pendant_task_create
tools.description: Create a task or reminder from pendant voice input. Supports time-based and location-based triggers.

tools.name: pendant_task_list
tools.description: List pending tasks and reminders

tools.name: pendant_task_complete
tools.description: Mark a task as completed. Can identify task by ID, position, or text match.

tools.name: pendant_task_delete
tools.description: Delete a task. Can identify by ID, position, or text match.

tools.name: pendant_task_clear_completed
tools.description: Remove all completed tasks from the list

tools.name: location_save
tools.description: Save the current location with a name for geofencing

tools.name: location_list
tools.description: List all saved locations

tools.name: location_update
tools.description: Update a saved location's name, radius, or starred status

tools.name: location_delete
tools.description: Delete a saved location

tools.name: location_group_create
tools.description: Create a new location group (e.g., Grocery Stores, Offices)

tools.name: location_group_add
tools.description: Add a location to a group

tools.name: location_group_remove
tools.description: Remove a location from a group

tools.name: location_group_list
tools.description: List all location groups with their locations

tools.name: person_profile_create
tools.description: Create a profile for a person to track their locations and info

tools.name: person_profile_update
tools.description: Update a person's profile information

tools.name: person_profile_list
tools.description: List all people profiles

tools.name: person_profile_get
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific person

tools.name: person_location_add
tools.description: Add a location tag to a person (e.g., "John's home is at...")

tools.name: person_location_remove
tools.description: Remove a location tag from a person

tools.name: person_location_list
tools.description: List all saved locations for a person

tools.name: person_voice_link
tools.description: Link a voice profile to a person (for speaker identification)

tools.name: pendant_memory_status
tools.description: Get status and statistics of the pendant memory auto-save system

tools.name: pendant_memory_flush
tools.description: Manually flush all pending transcripts to memory files

emits.name: pendant.transcript
emits.description: Emitted when audio is transcribed. Contains transcript, speaker info, and detected intent.

emits.name: pendant.intent
emits.description: Emitted when an intent is detected from a transcript.

emits.name: pendant.task.created
emits.description: Emitted when a task is created from voice input.

emits.name: pendant.task.triggered
emits.description: Emitted when a location-based task is triggered.

emits.name: pendant.task.list
emits.description: Emitted with task list when user asks to see tasks.

emits.name: pendant.location.saved
emits.description: Emitted when a location is saved. Android should register geofence.

emits.name: pendant.location.updated
emits.description: Emitted when a location is updated. Android should update geofence.

emits.name: pendant.location.deleted
emits.description: Emitted when a location is deleted. Android should remove geofence.

emits.name: pendant.person.location.added
emits.description: Emitted when a location is added to a person profile.

emits.name: channel.message
emits.description: Emitted for AI to process transcripts as channel messages.

listens.name: pendant.audio
listens.description: Receives PCM audio data from pendant via Android node.

listens.name: pendant.geofence.enter
listens.description: Receives geofence enter events from Android location service.

listens.name: pendant.geofence.exit
listens.description: Receives geofence exit events from Android location service.
